rules: Fact namespace is exam for every fact of this chapter; the four fixed ids above must exist with exactly those names (tools/web/shell.json reads them). If a page states a different value, the quote wins and the id keeps its name.
Quote from page snapshots only (show --around). The FAQ index _build/corpus/faq/certification.jsonl is a finder; the quote comes from www/certification/faqs.

HTML snapshots put a heading and its value on separate lines (exam page: '### Exam duration' then '130 minutes'). Quote the value line as the quote and name the heading in the claim; for table rows (price table, recertification table) quote the row plus table_header.
The sample-questions PDF (_build/work/01-how-the-exam-asks/sample-questions.pdf) is a format reference only. No fact and no quote comes from it.
No change item on a What's New feed applies: this chapter has no service. The FRESHNESS hypotheses (d039 to d043) are checked against the saved exam-guide pages and the exam page only.
No case study and no Callvale decision record in this template: skip cases and story items.
Heuristic items (d044 to d056) need no fact unless the writer states a number; mine the exam guide's own phrasing for each word group so that the writer can quote the guide where the word appears.

numbers-behavior-changes.what: Every number and limit of the exam (count, split, minutes, score and scale, weights, days, hours, fees, validity, experience) and every can-or-cannot rule of the exam (unscored questions not identified, no penalty for guessing, compensatory scoring, scaled scores, breaks, ID rules, accommodation timing, retake rules, result timing), plus the FRESHNESS hypotheses about the exam guide itself (current names, retired services still in scope, two question types). Behavior facts need two displays (gate B12).

decisions-faq.what: The decision rules the chapter teaches (what a distractor is, choose the best available answer, the 3-month rule for new features, replaced questions after a change), the quick-fire FAQ rows with verbatim FAQ answers (results, retake, reschedule, cost, prerequisites, beta exams, practice material, verification, no coding), and the exam guide's own phrasing for each of the nine exam-English word groups and the confusable pairs, so that the writer quotes the guide where the word appears and marks the rest as method.

not_used.why: Index pages and the appeals/code-of-conduct page: no exam fact the chapter needs.

known_disagreements: Exam price refresh month: FAQ #32 says 'updated annually in April'; before-testing says 'at least annually in May'. The chapter states neither.

FAQ #42 says 'AWS does not publish exam passing scores'; the exam guide and after-testing publish 720 for Associate. The guide wins; the FAQ sentence explains that the raw count of correct answers is not published.
